clue.text: Rich people showering Lionel Messi with endless praise

indicators.note: showering suggests a spray scattering in all directions, so these letters are flung into a new order
endless means the word praise loses its first and last letters

explanation.surface: A footballer is being drenched in compliments, perhaps by fans.
explanation.walkthrough: 'endless' trims praise to RAIS, which joins LIONELMESSI in the anagram signalled by 'showering'.
explanation.definitionFit: The answer names wealthy women, so the plural phrase covers them as rich folk.

clue.text: Couple's sexual relations upset me

parts.note: IT is a coy slang word for sex

indicators.note: upset in a down entry means tipped over, so the word me is read upwards

explanation.surface: Someone is troubled by a pair's love life.
explanation.definitionFit: An established romantic pair is called an item in everyday slang.

clue.text: Slow-moving glacier melts, engulfing empty trench

indicators.note: engulfing means one set of letters swallows the other
melts suggests something losing its shape, so these letters are rearranged
empty means trench loses everything but its outer letters

explanation.surface: An image of a glacier swallowing a ditch as it melts, slowly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'melts' rearranges GLACIER to LEARGIC, which by 'engulfing' takes in TH ('empty' trench).
explanation.definitionFit: A sluggish, drowsy state is lethargy, so something sluggish is described by this adjective.

clue.text: Shaq — basketball's ultimate draw?

parts.note: Shaq is the nickname of the basketball player Shaquille O'Neal

indicators.note: ultimate means the final letter of the word basketball's is taken

explanation.surface: Was the famous centre's last game in basketball a tie?
explanation.walkthrough: Shaq is Shaquille O'Neal; add L, the last letter of basketball (the 's is ignored).
explanation.definitionFit: A score level at one goal each is a tied result, a kind of draw.

clue.text: One Italian MP tries working against expansionism

indicators.note: working means the letters are worked over into a new arrangement

parts.note: one as a Roman numeral is I

explanation.surface: An Italian politician is busily campaigning against empire building.
explanation.definitionFit: Opposing imperial expansion of territory is the core position of this political stance.

clue.text: Coming to and in pain again?

parts.note: RE is a prefix meaning again
aching means hurting, in pain

explanation.surface: A question of whether regaining consciousness means hurting once more.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Coming to' looks like waking up; here it means arriving at or getting to.
explanation.definitionFit: Getting to a place or total is arriving at it, matching coming to.

clue.text: Pitch from film director cutting a lot of ice

indicators.note: cutting means removing the second piece from the first

parts.note: Steven Spielberg is a film director
a berg is an iceberg, a large mass of ice

explanation.surface: A director makes a sales pitch, perhaps for an Arctic film.
explanation.definitionFit: A sales talk or patter meant to persuade is a pitch, also called a spiel.

clue.text: Odd people heavily focused on Europe, essentially obsessive

indicators.note: on means the focused piece is placed after, resting on, the Europe piece

parts.note: EC stands for the European Community
centric means concentrated on a centre, strongly focused

indicators.note: essentially means the central letter of obsessive is taken

explanation.surface: Someone is obsessively fixated on Europe, perhaps a Eurosceptic.
explanation.definitionFit: Unconventional folk with quirky habits are oddballs, or eccentrics.

clue.text: After initially swallowing ecstasy tablet when drunk, this may save your life

indicators.note: After places the anagram after the first two letters
initially means the first letter of swallowing is taken

parts.note: E is slang for the drug ecstasy

indicators.note: when drunk means the letters stagger into a new order

explanation.surface: A warning about driving after taking a pill and drinking.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface reads as a drug warning; 'After' puts the drunk tablet behind S + E, and the definition is a whole descriptive phrase.
explanation.definitionFit: Car safety belts are fitted because they prevent deaths in crashes.

clue.text: A gun for each person

parts.note: piece is slang for a handgun

explanation.surface: A firearm is handed out to every individual.
explanation.definitionFit: Each, apiece and per head all mean one to every person.

clue.text: Hit single in From Dusk till Dawn?

definitions.meaning: a 1983 hit song by Lionel Richie

explanation.surface: A hit song featured in a vampire film.
explanation.walkthrough: From Dusk till Dawn is a film title, but here it simply means through the night.
explanation.definitionFit: Lionel Richie's hit carries this title, and the phrase means throughout the night.

clue.text: RV with a phone in

parts.note: a mobile is a mobile phone
to be in is to be at home

explanation.surface: A recreational vehicle that has a phone inside.
explanation.walkthrough: RV is American shorthand for a recreational vehicle.
explanation.definitionFit: A recreational vehicle is a house on wheels, a dwelling you can drive.

clue.text: Tennis player in Bilbao, relaxing on vacation

indicators.note: on vacation means the words are vacated, emptied of their insides, leaving their outer letters

explanation.surface: A tennis star unwinding on holiday in a Spanish city.
explanation.walkthrough: 'on vacation' looks like holiday detail; it empties Bilbao to BO and relaxing to RG.
explanation.definitionFit: Björn Borg was a Swedish champion, a five-time Wimbledon winner.

clue.text: Joke by one politician is intended to do damage

parts.note: a pun is a joke based on wordplay
one as a Roman numeral is I
a Tory is a British Conservative politician

explanation.surface: A politician's jest is meant to hurt someone.
explanation.definitionFit: Punitory measures inflict punishment, so they are meant to cause harm.

clue.text: Got up and went to an event

definitions.meaning: dressed and groomed, as in well got up
attended, as in crowds who came out

explanation.surface: Someone rose from bed and attended an occasion.
explanation.definitionFit: Being dressed smartly is being well turned out; showing up for an event is turning out.

clue.text: Explorer and crew taking a set line

indicators.note: taking means the first piece holds the rest inside it

parts.note: to man a ship is to crew it
to gel is to set, as a jelly does

explanation.surface: An explorer and his sailors set a course.
explanation.walkthrough: MAN, by 'taking', surrounds A + GEL + L.
explanation.definitionFit: Ferdinand Magellan led the first expedition to sail round the world.

clue.text: British inventor, from that time on, nearly left an impression

indicators.note: nearly means the last letter is dropped

parts.note: since means from then onwards
an air is an impression or appearance someone gives off

explanation.surface: A British inventor who made a lasting mark.
explanation.definitionFit: Sir Clive Sinclair created home computers and the C5 electric trike.

clue.text: Vehicle brought back to Spain for the Barcelona GP?

indicators.note: brought back means the word is read backwards

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
E is the international vehicle code for Spain

explanation.surface: A car returned to Spain for the Grand Prix.
explanation.walkthrough: 'brought back' turns CAR into RAC; the question mark marks the definition as an example.
explanation.definitionFit: The Spanish Grand Prix held near Barcelona is one motor race, an example.

clue.text: Several old people entering a swimming pool

definitions.meaning: an archaic word for several or sundry
plungers who go into water head first

explanation.surface: A few elderly folk wade into the pool.
explanation.walkthrough: 'old' marks the first sense as archaic; 'Several old people' is one phrase on the surface.
explanation.definitionFit: Divers once meant sundry, and also names folk who plunge into water.

clue.text: Profitable and extremely resolute venture I am arranging

indicators.note: extremely means the extreme letters of resolute are taken
arranging means the letters are put into a new order

explanation.surface: Planning a venture with determination that pays well.
explanation.walkthrough: 'extremely' takes RE from resolute; 'arranging' turns VENTUREIAM into MUNERATIVE.
explanation.definitionFit: Well-paid or lucrative work brings in money, so it pays.

clue.text: Extremist involved in awful tragedy

indicators.note: involved in means the letters are wrapped inside these words

explanation.surface: A fanatic took part in a terrible tragedy.
explanation.definitionFit: A die-hard holding extreme views, especially in politics, is called an ultra.

clue.text: A good place to gamble and lie around

indicators.note: around means the word is turned round

parts.note: a oner is slang for a big lie, a whopper

explanation.surface: Somewhere to bet and lounge about.
explanation.definitionFit: The Nevada city is famous for its casinos, a gambling destination.

clue.text: From the get-go, celebs on Instagram mostly chat about sex

indicators.note: From the get-go means the first letter of each word is taken
mostly means the word loses its last letter

parts.note: talk is chat

explanation.surface: Famous people online gossip mostly about sex.
explanation.definitionFit: Coital is the adjective for sexual intercourse, so it means concerning sex.

clue.text: Going round Spar, for example, I can primarily see counter and freezers

indicators.note: primarily means the first letter of can is taken
Going round means the first piece surrounds the second
counter means the word see runs the opposite way

parts.note: to spar is to box, an example of boxing practice

explanation.surface: A shopper in a Spar store sees the counter and the frozen food.
explanation.walkthrough: Spar is a British convenience store chain, so 'counter' and 'freezers' look like shop fittings; here spar means box, and counter is a reversal signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Iceboxes are old-fashioned refrigerators or freezer compartments.

clue.text: Making unattractive noise, it managed to break over time

indicators.note: over means the anagram lies over the letter, surrounding it
to break means the letters are broken up and reassembled

explanation.surface: A noise managed to interrupt, perhaps during extra time.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Making unattractive' looks like spoiling looks; here it is removing magnetism. 'over' places the anagram around T.
explanation.definitionFit: Removing magnetism means a magnet no longer attracts metal.
